measurement.latency: client SSL_connect only; server SSL_accept recorded separately
measurement.warm: one context/process per block, first 2 full handshakes retained but excluded from summary; no resumption
measurement.cold: new process/context each connection; no warmup exclusion
measurement.blocks: 5 rounds per latency mode; each round shuffles 43 configurations with fixed seed; one AWS execution, not independent instance replications
measurement.memory: separate cold run, reset Linux VmHWM immediately before SSL call; peak increase over reset baseline; not allocation bytes
measurement.bytes: message callback TLS handshake message bytes, directional; excludes record headers/TCP/IP
measurement.network: host networking on EC2; same-AZ private IPv4

deployment.controller: local AWS CLI; not a GitHub Actions run
